parsed.rationale: All five records are `type-alias-object` kinds with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning the structural pipeline detected identical shape solely because each file declares a type alias at roughly the same line with no members. The names `AppleMusicService`, `BandcampService`, `SoundCloudService`, `SpotifyService`, and `YouTubeMusicService` represent five distinct third-party music platform integrations whose coincidental structural identity (an empty type alias) does not imply shared logic that can be extracted. Because `fields_or_signature` is empty for every record, there is no concrete method or field body to consolidate, and the `shared_field_count: 1` in `structural_evidence` reflects only the alias declaration itself rather than any reusable implementation. Collapsing these into a single generic or common type would erase meaningful domain distinctions between unrelated external services.
